::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 24th 1862  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1862/3
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I enclose a cheque for the amount of the [Banks of the Thorne](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd)that has gone in this time, and I think has been very much liked.

I have had an offer of [Mrs Sherwood](people/person_1869.qmd)’s Life from a person who can get at something about her privately so I thought you would not mind my accepting it, as a little beyond a published memoir is such a gain.[^1]

You see the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) is flourishing and can [pay](organizations/other_102.qmd) a little more this time

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Carter Smith had evidently offered to contribute a life of Sherwood to the *Biographies of Good Women*;  however none appeared in either of the two series.
